With no sweet fruits of any kind, this is our most rigorous detox, suitable for green juice fans and intermediate to advanced cleansers.

This is a demonstration store. You can purchase products like this from Greenhouse Juice.

Meet the Green Bundle:

5 Cold-pressed Juices

3 Lemonades

1 Shake

2 Boosters

Are you a title-holding Cleanser, atop the podium with a gold cup (filled with green juice, of course)? This one’s for you. The organic Cold-pressed Juices included each day deliver a rainbow of nutrients (admittedly, a mostly green rainbow) with no sweet fruit ingredients for our lowest-sugar Cleanse. Unique in that it features a fifth juice, in place of a second Shake, the Green Cleanse provides more nutrients from plant ingredients and fewer overall calories.


Share

IN CASE YOU’RE WONDERING

Frequently asked questions
What's the shelf life?

Guaranteed 10 days on delivery. See the label for the best before date. Once opened, drink within 5 days. Keep below 4°C.

How much is shipping?
What's inside?
More plants. More often.
Next-day delivery

Order by 10pm and wake up to your order of organic drinks on your doorstep! Next-day delivery is available across most of Canada and the USA.

Carbon offsetting

We carbon-offset every one of our home deliveries. Currently, our donations support Pachama's Jari Pará Project, which protects the Amazonian Rainforest.

Our drinks are bottled in glass, never plastic. It’s better for you, better for the planet, and more fun to drink from.
